products.title: CHAPARRAL SUN
products.body_html: A gentler take on the classic cat-eye, the Chaparral Sun keeps things period-accurate with a narrow, upswept rectangle shape that is finished with temple plaques true to the era it borrows from. 100% UV protection comes standard and statement colorways keep one foot planted in the past and the other stepping into the now.

products.title: LUGO SUN
products.body_html: A shallower wayfarer silhouette, the Lugo Sun plays yin to an enduring, decades-old cat-eye's yang. Rich materials, slightly exaggerated end pieces, bold lens tints and acetate color pairings. Dialed-back lines and old-soul construction, it’s sophisticated and striking in equal measure. 100% UV protection rounds out a build with real vintage weight.

products.title: HANCOCK SUN
products.body_html: A rounder member of the aviator and navigator family, the Hancock Sun carries forward a classic teardrop shape with real pedigree, one that has flattered a wide range of face shapes for decades. Details like GLCO’s dual-plated hinges and original core wire root the design in old-world optical craftsmanship. Part aviator, part navigator, all charm - the Hancock Sun brings two classic lineages together in one distinct silhouette. 100% UV protection.

products.title: VERDUGO SUN
products.body_html: An evolution of one of our legacy frames, the Verdugo Sun brings clean lines and an easy, everyday thickness to a refined outline. Its classic, tapered GLCO temple is finished with our signature hinge, rivets, and core wire – heritage details built for daily wear. Equal parts throwback and update, it's the modern sun essential your rotation's been missing. 100% UV Protection.

products.title: DOMINGUEZ SUN
products.body_html: The Dominguez Sun is a true vintage vision, built around a prominent, perfectly proportioned square frame inspired by timeless late-1960s design. Comfort and all-day wearability were carefully considered without compromising its classic silhouette. Rooted in a specific era, its universal appeal feels as relevant today as ever. 100% UV protection.

products.title: HAMPTON SUN
products.body_html: From our original collection 10 years ago, Hampton Sun continues to be one of our best-selling styles for both men and women, striking the perfect balance of casual and refined. The frame sports a retro-inspired P3 silhouette for a classic look, while contemporary color combinations lend it a fresh, modern feel. Featuring Premium Glass lenses and 100% UV protection.

products.title: KINNEY II SUN
products.body_html: A thicker version of our forever classic, Kinney Sun. Kinney II Sun maintains the same classic proportions and flattering shape with 2 pins and Premium Glass, offering a formidable take on a timeless design. 100% UV protection.

products.title: ACE SUN
products.body_html:
With bold lines and fine details, the Ace is for the strong and not-so-silent types. Featuring a palm leaf plaque adorning the frame front and glass lenses for unmatched clarity, the Ace is a striking choice for the discerning wearer.

Appearances matter, and no one lives this better than the wearer of the Ace. Assured and well-connected, he's the guy who always gets it right.

products.title: MORNINGSIDE SUN
products.body_html: The Morningside Sun is an oversized round frame, inspired by the 80's, in our ultra-thin acetate. The chic rounded frames come in colorful pastel and classic colorways paired with semi-flat colored lenses.

products.title: LAURICE SUN
products.body_html: Laurice Sun pairs soft curves with sculpted volume for a bold, polished silhouette. Triple pin detailing adds a flash of shine, while gradient lenses and rich acetate colors bring layered dimension. 100% UV protection.

products.title: TEMESCAL SUN
products.body_html: Temescal Sun is a hexagon frame with intriguing angles and a clean silhouette. Fitted with GLCO’s dual-plated rivet hinges, polished pins, and original core wire, it is paired with pure glass lenses. 100% UV protection.

products.title: FELIZ SUN
products.body_html: Feliz Sun is a gently sculpted frame featuring an uplifting almond-shaped eye and petite bridge fit. Refined proportions are complemented by understated detailing, including GLCO's smallest signature plaque hardware. Lightweight, elegant, and designed for everyday flattering, expressive wear.

products.title: LILITH SUN
products.body_html: Lilith Sun introduces a whole new proportion to the GLCO collection. With an expansive 149mm frame width, its oversized fit remains balanced and refined through a slim profile and clean lines. Designed for anyone seeking a bolder silhouette, the Lilith Sun pairs contemporary scale with timeless detailing.

products.title: ALPER SUN
products.body_html: Alper Sun is a retro-inspired oval frame crafted in metal with an acetate insert for added structure and depth. The design is anchored by a Fern filigree bridge, grooved endpieces, and temples with integrated spring hinges for a flexible, secure fit. Adjustable nose pads provide comfort, while the lenses deliver 100% UV protection.

products.title: DOC SUN
products.body_html: Doc Sun combines a classic silhouette with bold colorways. Its commanding double bridge and large frame stand out, finished with GLCO temple ball and pins for a distinctive touch and 100% UV protection.

products.title: PALMERA SUN
products.body_html: Palmera Sun is a bold, oversized silhouette with sculpted topline angles and sharp beveling that gives the frame its striking edge. Designed in fresh tones, this acetate style balances graphic volume with refined detailing. 100% UV protection.

products.title: EARVIN SUN
products.body_html: Earvin Sun takes us back with a classic, strong silhouette. Its oversized square lenses and keyhole bridge offer presence with comfort. Available in polar lens options. 100% UV protection.

products.title: FLIPPER SUN
products.body_html: Flipper Sun features a thick, super round frame with flared endpieces, creating a bold silhouette. Available in contrasting pop colors, it includes Premium Glass Lenses and our signature GLCO water drop plaque. 100% UV protection.

products.title: OCAMPO SUN
products.body_html: Ocampo Sun is a round metal frame reimagined with a removable side-shield clip-on that delivers both utility and edge. Detailed with art deco etching across the bridge and shield, the step-up end piece and enamel-coated components add a subtle sculptural dimension. Built with titanium screw-in nose pads and acetate temple tips. 100% UV protection.

products.title: MCNALLY SUN
products.body_html: McNally Sun is a modern brow-line aviator with soft curves and a subtle lift. Detailed with polished vertical pins and GLCO’s classic dual-plated rivet hinges and core wire. 100% UV protection.

products.title: WELLS J SUN
products.body_html: A refined metal silhouette with thoughtful detailing, Wells J Sun balances modern proportion with subtle craftsmanship. Designed in lightweight titanium, the frame features a distinctive half double-rim construction that adds dimension without visual weight. Sculpted bridge and temple details are finished with delicate floral filigree, offering a quiet, subtle design detail. Finished with pure glass lenses. 100% UV protection.

products.title: LACHMAN SUN
products.body_html: Lachman Sun is a tailored unisex frame with a smooth saddle bridge and subtle angular detailing along the top line. Clean-lined and versatile, it features GLCO’s signature dual-plated rivet hinges with polished pins and classic original core wire, bringing modern structure to a familiar silhouette.100% UV protection.
